create_autotune_decorator: create a triton kernel autotuner decorator that benchmarks multiple configs and caches the fastest one
run_autotuner_class: run the Autotuner class to benchmark and select the best kernel configuration for a triton JIT function
bench_kernel_config: bench a triton kernel configuration using 40 repetitions and return median, 20th, and 80th percentile timings
prune_matmul_configs: prune matmul kernel configurations by shrinking block sizes based on M, N, K dimensions to reduce tuning overhead
warmup_autotuned_kernel: warmup an autotuned triton kernel by compiling all pruned configurations before the first real run
